marketLayer.title: HK Tech & Cloud AI Infrastructure
marketLayer.fact: Leading Hong Kong-listed tech platforms reported accelerated enterprise adoption of generative AI tools and double-digit growth in Q2 cloud compute utilization.
marketLayer.inference: Commercialization of AI application layers is beginning to translate into tangible top-line contributions, supporting structural re-rating across major HK internet software names.
marketLayer.keyUncertainty: Execution risks regarding local infrastructure costs and persistent US export controls on advanced hardware.

marketLayer.title: US Semiconductor & AI Hardware
marketLayer.fact: Major US semiconductor equities sustained positive momentum following upgraded supply-chain production schedules for next-generation data center architectures.
marketLayer.inference: Capital expenditure commitments from mega-cap hyperscalers remain robust, insulating hardware vendors from broader macroeconomic cooling.
marketLayer.keyUncertainty: Elevated valuation multiples leave key AI chipmakers vulnerable to minor earnings or guidance misses.

marketLayer.title: HK Auto & EV Export Expansion
marketLayer.fact: Chinese EV manufacturers listed in Hong Kong announced record monthly export volumes alongside new distribution partnerships in Southeast Asia and Latin America.
marketLayer.inference: Rapid overseas expansion offers an effective margin buffer against intense domestic price competition in the mainland market.
marketLayer.keyUncertainty: Evolving trade policies, including potential tariffs and anti-subsidy scrutiny in Western destinations.
